title: U.S.–China Technology and AI Permissions Constitution — 2026
adds: No single restriction: a stack of object-specific permission systems (jurisdiction -> classification -> destination -> entity/ownership -> end use -> knowledge -> decision -> transaction -> delivery -> use). The EAR reaches more than physical exports; China is not under a blanket chip embargo (H200/MI325X-class case-by-case since 2026-01-13, eligibility is not a license); compute, training, weights and inference are distinct; CFIUS and the outbound program are separate gates; China runs its own export, entity, data and public-AI-service gates; nationality is not a complete talent rule; permission is not operation.
